svg.aria-label: Logarithmic comparison of one potted plant's clean air delivery rate against a room's ventilation rate, with a floor plan showing the density of planting that would be needed to match it.
svg.text: AT ONE AIR CHANGE AN HOUR
B · WHAT THE ARITHMETIC ASKS FOR
THE SAME ROOM AT THE LOWER BOUND
AND THE UPPER BOUND IS A HUNDRED TIMES DENSER AGAIN
To match one air change an hour with potted plants you need ten to a thousand of them per square
metre of floor. That is not a larger version of the usual planting. It is a different order of thing.
MEDIAN CADR PER PLANT FROM CUMMINGS AND WARING 2020, 196 RESULTS · ROOM RATE FROM 30 M² × 2.5 M
AT ONE AIR CHANGE AN HOUR. THE 1,000-PER-M² UPPER BOUND IS THE PAPER’S OWN.
